Remote SSH utilities

Usage:
  erun sshd [command]

Available Commands:
  init        Enable SSH access for a remote environment

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for sshd

Global Flags:
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase trace verbosity. -v logs command flow and side effects.

Use "erun sshd [command] --help" for more information about a command.
